questions.subtopic: ICC complementarity under Rome Statute Article 17
questions.stem: Under Article 17 of the Rome Statute, which circumstance can make a case admissible before the ICC despite domestic proceedings?
options: The State with jurisdiction is unwilling or unable genuinely to investigate or prosecute the case.
The domestic court is located outside the country's capital.
The accused disagrees with a national court's decision and files an ordinary appeal to the ICC.
The alleged offence has affected citizens of more than one country.
explanations: Correct. Under Article 17, a case may be admissible when the State with jurisdiction is unwilling or unable genuinely to carry out the investigation or prosecution, subject to the Statute's other admissibility requirements.
The location of a domestic court does not determine ICC admissibility under the complementarity principle.
The ICC is not an ordinary appellate court for national criminal judgments.
Cross-border effects alone do not establish admissibility; the Rome Statute's jurisdiction and admissibility conditions still apply.
questions.basis: Official Paper I syllabus: International Relations and Events. Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, Article 17; ICC official complementarity guidance: https://asp.icc-cpi.int/complementarity

questions.topic: Physical, Social and Economic Geography of India
questions.subtopic: Northeast monsoon: October–December rainfall over Tamil Nadu and adjoining southeast India
questions.stem: The India Meteorological Department identifies the northeast monsoon as an important October–December rainfall season for which of the following regions?
options: Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal, along with adjoining southeast peninsular subdivisions.
Punjab and Haryana in the northwestern plains.
Western Rajasthan and the Thar Desert.
The Konkan coast of Maharashtra and Goa as its principal beneficiary.
explanations: Correct. The IMD's northeast-monsoon seasonal reports identify Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal among the key subdivisions benefiting from October–December northeast-monsoon rainfall.
Punjab and Haryana receive most of their principal monsoon rainfall during the southwest monsoon, not the northeast-monsoon season.
Western Rajasthan is not the principal region identified for northeast-monsoon rainfall.
The Konkan coast is primarily associated with southwest-monsoon rainfall; it is not the key southeast-peninsular northeast-monsoon region.
questions.basis: Official Paper I syllabus: Physical, Social and Economic Geography of India. India Meteorological Department, Northeast Monsoon 2024 seasonal report (October–December): https://mausam.imd.gov.in/chennai/mcdata/ne_monsoon_2024.pdf

questions.topic: Socio-economic, Political and Cultural History of Modern India with special emphasis on Indian National Movement
questions.subtopic: Khilafat movement: identification of the Ali Brothers
questions.stem: Which pair of leaders became popularly known as the Ali Brothers and led the Khilafat movement in India?
options: Abul Kalam Azad and Hakim Ajmal Khan.
Lala Lajpat Rai and Bal Gangadhar Tilak.
explanations: Correct. Muhammad Ali and Shaukat Ali were popularly known as the Ali Brothers and were leading figures in the Khilafat movement.
Abul Kalam Azad and Hakim Ajmal Khan were prominent public figures, but they were not the Ali Brothers.
Motilal Nehru and C. R. Das were associated with the Swaraj Party, not the Ali Brothers identity.
Lala Lajpat Rai and Bal Gangadhar Tilak were prominent nationalist leaders from an earlier political context; they were not the Ali Brothers.

questions.topic: Social Exclusion; Rights issues such as Gender, Caste, Tribe, Disability etc. and inclusive policies
questions.subtopic: Article 30(1): minority right to establish and administer educational institutions
questions.stem: A religious or linguistic minority plans to establish and administer an educational institution of its choice. Which constitutional safeguard directly protects this right?
explanations: Correct. Article 30(1) gives religious and linguistic minorities the right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice.
Article 29(1) protects the right of any section of citizens with a distinct language, script or culture to conserve it.
Article 26 concerns the right of religious denominations to manage their own affairs in matters of religion and related matters.
Article 16 concerns equality of opportunity in matters of public employment.

questions.subtopic: C11 volatile qualifier versus atomic synchronization
questions.stem: Two C11 threads access a shared `volatile int flag`; one writes while the other reads, without an atomic operation or a lock. Which statement is correct?
options: The volatile qualifier makes every read and write indivisible, so the access is automatically thread-safe.
The volatile qualifier creates a release/acquire synchronizes-with relationship between the threads.
The volatile qualifier alone provides neither atomicity nor inter-thread synchronization; use a C atomic object or a mutex for thread-safe communication.
The volatile qualifier automatically orders all ordinary memory accesses made by both threads.
explanations: Incorrect. C's volatile qualifier does not promise indivisible accesses; atomicity must come from an atomic type or another synchronization mechanism.
Incorrect. C volatile does not create a release/acquire synchronizes-with relationship between threads.

Correct. In C11, volatile affects treatment of accesses but does not itself make them atomic or establish inter-thread synchronization. Conflicting unsynchronized non-atomic accesses can constitute a data race; use `_Atomic` operations or a mutex.
Incorrect. Volatile does not impose a global ordering on ordinary non-volatile memory accesses across threads.
questions.basis: Official Paper II syllabus: Programming in C. SEI CERT C CON02-C, Do not use volatile as a synchronization primitive: https://cmu-sei.github.io/secure-coding-standards/sei-cert-c-coding-standard/recommendations/concurrency-con/con02-c/ ; WG14 N1479, C atomic versus volatile rationale: https://www.open-std.org/jtc1/sc22/wg14/www/docs/n1479.htm

questions.subtopic: Loop unrolling as a compiler code-optimisation technique
questions.stem: An optimizing compiler duplicates a loop body several times within one iteration so that fewer loop-control branches are executed. Which optimization is being applied?
explanations: Correct. Loop unrolling replicates the loop body and adjusts the iteration step, reducing loop-control overhead at the possible cost of increased code size.
Loop-invariant code motion moves computations that do not change across iterations outside the loop; it does not primarily duplicate the body.
Strength reduction replaces an expensive operation with a cheaper equivalent operation, often inside a loop.
Dead-code elimination removes computations whose results are not needed; it does not replicate loop iterations.
questions.basis: Official Paper II syllabus: Compiler Design; basics of code optimisation. LLVM documentation, Analysis and Transform Passes, `loop-unroll`: https://www.llvm.org/docs/Passes.html

questions.subtopic: UML sequence diagrams: meaning and notation of a lifeline
questions.stem: In a UML sequence interaction, what is the name of the vertical dashed line that descends from a participant's head?
explanations: Correct. The vertical dashed line is the lifeline, representing the participant's presence in the interaction over time.
An activation bar, or execution specification, is drawn as a narrow rectangle on a lifeline to show an execution period.
A message is shown by an arrow between lifelines, not by the vertical dashed line itself.
A combined fragment encloses part of an interaction to express operators such as alt, opt or loop.
questions.basis: Official Paper II syllabus: Information Systems and Software Engineering; introduction to UML. Object Management Group, UML 2.5.1, Sequence Diagrams and Lifeline classifier: https://www.omg.org/spec/UML/2.5.1/PDF

questions.stem: An ideal Stop-and-Wait ARQ link has one-way propagation delay four times the frame transmission time, so a = Tₚ/Tₜ = 4. Ignoring acknowledgement transmission and processing delays, what is the link utilisation?
explanations: Incorrect. This is 1/(1+a), which omits the return propagation delay of the acknowledgement.
Incorrect. The ideal utilisation is 1/9, not 8%.
Incorrect. The propagation-to-transmission ratio does not produce a utilisation of 4/9; the denominator is 1 + 2a.
questions.basis: Official Paper II syllabus: Computer Networks; flow and error control. National Institute of Technology Srinagar, Unit III notes, Stop-and-Wait link utilisation: https://nitsri.ac.in/Department/Electronics%20%26%20Communication%20Engineering/Unit_III.pdf

questions.stem: A servlet must pass the current request to a JSP on the same server, preserving the same request and response objects and avoiding a new browser request. Which operation is appropriate?
options: Set the response status to 302 and continue writing the JSP output.
Invalidate the HTTP session and return without dispatching.
explanations: Incorrect. `sendRedirect` sends a redirect response to the client; the browser then makes a new request to the target URL.
Correct. `RequestDispatcher.forward` performs a server-side dispatch to another resource using the current request and response objects.
A 302 status instructs the client to redirect; it is not an internal server-side forward.
Invalidating the session does not dispatch the current request to the JSP.
questions.basis: Official Paper II syllabus: Web Technologies; Servlets. Jakarta Servlet 6.0 API, RequestDispatcher.forward: https://jakarta.ee/specifications/servlet/6.0/apidocs/jakarta.servlet/jakarta/servlet/requestdispatcher ; HttpServletResponse.sendRedirect: https://jakarta.ee/specifications/servlet/6.0/apidocs/jakarta.servlet/jakarta/servlet/http/httpservletresponse

questions.subtopic: Support vector machines: kernel trick and implicit feature mapping
questions.stem: An SVM implementation evaluates K(x,z)=⟨φ(x),φ(z)⟩ directly from x and z, without constructing φ(x) or φ(z). What computational idea is being used?
explanations: Correct. The kernel trick evaluates the inner product that would result from an implicit feature mapping without explicitly constructing the mapped feature vectors.
One-hot encoding represents categorical values with binary indicator features; it is not the implicit inner-product calculation described.
Bootstrap aggregation trains models on resampled datasets and combines their predictions; it is an ensemble technique.
Feature scaling changes the numerical scale of input features; it does not replace explicit feature mapping with a kernel calculation.
questions.basis: Official Paper II syllabus: Data Mining; classification algorithms. scikit-learn User Guide, Support Vector Machines and kernel functions: https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/svm.html
